# Productivity & automation

Low-code automation, meeting notes, capture-and-document tools, and AI helpers for presentations, diagrams, and personal knowledge. Use these to remove repetitive steps, not to spray automation over a process you have not defined yet.

**Last verified:** October 22, 2026 · **16 tools**

[Back to the guide](../README.md) · [All categories](README.md) · [Safety checklist](../free-tier-safety.md)

> **Category tip:** Automations can share your data with every app in the chain. Grant the narrowest permissions that work, use test data first, and keep a way to turn a workflow off. Record meetings only with consent, and redact sensitive details before sending transcripts to a free tool.

**Start here:** [Zapier](#tool-zapier) · [Scribe](#tool-scribe) · [Gamma](#tool-gamma)

## All 16 tools

<a id="tool-zapier"></a>

### Zapier

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free plan for connecting apps and automating simple workflows, with AI-powered steps and a monthly task allowance.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account; no card for the free plan. Task and premium-step limits apply.
- **Limits:** Task volume, automation complexity, update frequency, and premium/AI steps are capped or paid. Free plans are best for learning and tiny workflows, not busy operations.
- **Best for:** A first automation, such as saving form responses to a spreadsheet or sending yourself a daily digest.
- **Official link:** <https://zapier.com>
- **Tags:** `automation` `integrations` `beginner` `workflows`

<a id="tool-make"></a>

### Make

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free plan with a monthly operations allowance, visual multi-step automations, and access to a large integration library.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account; no card. Monthly operations and active-scenario limits apply.
- **Limits:** Operations, active scenarios, scheduling interval, and advanced/AI modules are capped or paid. A multi-step scenario can burn through the allowance quickly during testing.
- **Best for:** Visual thinkers who want more branching logic than a simple two-step automation.
- **Official link:** <https://www.make.com>
- **Tags:** `automation` `visual-builder` `integrations` `workflows`

<a id="tool-n8n"></a>

### n8n

`Self-hosted` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A source-available automation platform you can self-host for complex workflows, AI steps, webhooks, and integrations under its current fair-code terms.
- **Sign-up notes:** Self-host from the official repository; no vendor account or card. You supply infrastructure, credentials, and maintenance.
- **Limits:** Self-hosting means running the server, updates, backups, and credentials. A capable host and model access cost money. The free plan does not include unlimited vendor cloud hosting.
- **Best for:** Technical users who want private, flexible AI automation without per-task cloud fees.
- **Official link:** <https://n8n.io>
- **Tags:** `automation` `self-hosted` `ai-workflows` `developer`

<a id="tool-activepieces"></a>

### Activepieces

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Open-source automation software with AI-capable pieces and a visual workflow builder, free to self-host.
- **Sign-up notes:** Self-host or use the free cloud account; no card for the free path. Hosted limits and AI provider costs may apply.
- **Limits:** Self-hosting requires maintenance and infrastructure. The hosted cloud has separate limits. AI model usage, integrations, and some features may need external accounts or API costs.

<a id="tool-bardeen"></a>

### Bardeen

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free monthly credit allowance for browser automations, data capture, and AI-assisted workflows that cut repetitive web tasks.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account and browser extension; no card. Monthly credits are limited.
- **Limits:** Credits and scheduled runs are capped, and advanced AI actions, teams, and higher volume are paid. Browser automation can break when a site changes, so verify results.
- **Best for:** Small research or prospecting chores that happen in your browser, such as collecting information from pages.

<a id="tool-khoj"></a>

### Khoj

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** An open-source personal AI assistant that can search your notes and documents and answer questions using local or remote models.

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22
